profile.headline: Embedded  Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Embedded Software Engineer working in Linux platforms.
I've been working primarily with Linux for over 5 Years in C and C++, during this time, was in charge of several applications such as mobile robots architectures (Inverse kinematics, user interface, Player Stage drivers). 

Like to document (Software Detailed Design), follow C/C++ Standards, develop clean and readable code. Problem solver, Passionate and enthusiast. 
Good knowledge on open source alternatives, APIs, Libraries, etc.

If a problem appears I usually work on it until the root cause is found, able to work under pressure.

Desiring to join a Linux team to work bringing up boards, developing test apps, low level apps, working with device drivers and kernel debugging, toolchains, etc.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer GNU/Linux
positions.description:
Responsible of the design and the development of the reprogramming module of the IPC unit, working together other team leads in order to achieve a successful reprogramming network for Cadillac car (With MOST and Ethernet). 

Developed an easy to use re-programing tool that was used by field engineers and manufacturing plants, saving several thousand of money in conventional tools. This tool used a Linux hardware with a OpenGLES interface and primarily developed in C++. 

Other activities as: Build BSPs, generating images for Manufacturing,  developing test code to validate hardware, version control administrator (GIT/Gerrit), software documentation, architectures, unit testing, coverage, static analysis tools.

Experience working with Freescale iMX5 and iMX6 and ATOM microprocessors.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Most of the activities on RyT was to research and develop mobile robots prototypes and write software.
One of the most important project that in which I had involved was the software control for an hexapod robot, including the lower level and higher level (transfer functions of the servo motors, inverse kinematics, TCP/IP client and server, serial port comunication with the motors drivers, linux libraries).
Setup and optimization of the RoBoard RB-100 with linux.
GUIs in GTK+, robot prototypes, and other projects were included in my activities.

company.name: Robotica y Tecnologia S.A. de C.V.
